procedures.title: Headlamp (sealed beam) replacement
steps: On Corvette, open the headlamp panel fully.
Take out the bezel screws and the bezel.
Unhook the spring from the retaining ring and remove the 2 ring screws.
Remove the ring, unplug the sealed beam at its connector and take it out.
Plug the connector onto the new unit and set it in place with the number molded in the lens at the top.
Refit the retaining ring with its screws and spring.
Check the lamp works, then refit the bezel.
notes: Inboard No. 1 lamps use a 2-terminal plug; outboard No. 2 lamps use a 3-terminal plug.
See figure 13 in the manual for the Corvette headlamp assembly.
